digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter user identity contract
propositions: Cloud and Data Center use different user identity keys (accountId vs name), causing assignee resolution to diverge in resolve_assignee and transport payload shapes
PR #120's DC implementation returned authoritative=False for every assignee because _assignee_resolver was never set, causing the diff to emit unconverged assignee changes on every pass (churn)

A UserIdentityModel Protocol with implementations AccountIdIdentity (Cloud) and NameIdentity (DC) pins the contract, where NameIdentity performs real DC user-search lookups to return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees
NameIdentity receives the resolver as an explicit constructor parameter rather than via getattr discovery, eliminating the unreachable authoritative branch
The 3-state resolve contract (value, authoritative, is_account_id) must hold identically for both implementations to prevent diff churn and support core's canonical-comparison fast-path
